description: This Java source file defines the CustomProductGroupsController class, which is a Spring MVC controller handling HTTP requests related to managing product groups in the admin interface of an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting product groups, as well as managing products within those groups.

classes.name: CustomProductGroupsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing product groups in the admin section of an e-commerce platform.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product groups management page.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated list of product groups.

methods.name: saveCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new product group after validation.

methods.name: removeCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product group.

methods.name: activateProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the active status of a product group.

methods.name: displayCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the details of a specific product group.

methods.name: pageProducts
